stories.narrEn: France 24 reports: Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in Poland on Friday in what Prime Minister Donald Tusk said was likely an "intentional provocation" timed to coincide with European military exercises in the country for a possible postwar mission in Ukraine. The Guardian reports: Russian missile and drone incident during western military exercises a ‘grave violation’ of Polish airspace, says Nato’s Rutte. RTÉ reports: Russia violated Poland's airspace overnight with three objects ⁠that were likely two missiles and a drone, the Polish defence minister has said. BBC reports: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.
